events.title: Columbus Lands on Puerto Rico
events.description: On his second voyage to the Americas, Christopher Columbus reached the island the Taíno people called Borikén. He named it San Juan Bautista. It later became known as Puerto Rico, meaning "rich port."
events.significance: The landing began Spanish colonization of Puerto Rico. That colonization reshaped the Caribbean and the lives of its Indigenous peoples.

events.title: Lincoln Delivers the Gettysburg Address
events.description: At the dedication of the Soldiers' National Cemetery in Pennsylvania, President Abraham Lincoln gave a speech of about 270 words. It came months after the Battle of Gettysburg, in the middle of the Civil War.
events.significance: The speech is one of the most celebrated in American history. It recast the war as a struggle for equality and a "new birth of freedom."

events.title: Indira Gandhi Is Born
events.description: Indira Gandhi was born in Allahabad, India. She was the daughter of Jawaharlal Nehru, India's first prime minister. She served four terms as prime minister and was assassinated in 1984.
events.significance: She was India's first and only female prime minister. She was one of the most powerful and polarizing leaders of the 20th century.

events.title: Apollo 12 Lands on the Moon
events.description: Astronauts Pete Conrad and Alan Bean touched down in the Ocean of Storms. They became the third and fourth humans to walk on the Moon, a few months after Apollo 11.
events.significance: The mission showed that NASA could land precisely at a chosen target. It also brought back lunar samples and instruments for scientific study.
